children: The eight state premiers from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives have backed the embattled leader in a joint statement, broadcaster ntv reported on Wednesday.
"The people can trust that we are addressing their problems. As state premiers, we want to - and will - contribute to this effort together with the chancellor," ntv cited the statement as saying.
